name: HIPAA Security Rule — §164.312 Technical Safeguards (AI Addendum)
scope: Covered entities and business associates handling electronic protected health information (ePHI), with AI-system addenda under active rulemaking
summary: Requires access control, audit controls, integrity, person-or-entity authentication, and transmission security for ePHI. AI addenda extend audit-control requirements to capture every AI-generated observation, decision, and PROV-O chain involving ePHI.

requirements.title: Access control — sensitivity tiering
requirements.description: Every ontology class that may reference ePHI must carry a sensitivity tier annotation so downstream access controls can enforce the minimum-necessary rule.

requirements.title: Audit controls — PROV-O observation attribution
requirements.description: Every observation involving ePHI must carry an agent attribution so the audit log can reconstruct who touched the data.

requirements.title: Audit controls — observed-at timestamp
requirements.description: Every observation must carry an observed_at timestamp recorded at capture time, not at retrieval time.

requirements.title: Integrity — SHACL validation gate
requirements.description: All inbound and outbound payloads crossing the agent boundary must be validated against a SHACL shape.

requirements.title: Entity authentication — named agent
requirements.description: Every observation must be attributable to a named agent IRI, not an anonymous source.

requirements.title: Transmission security — RESTRICTED tier at the federation boundary
requirements.description: RESTRICTED-tier observations must never cross the federation boundary to a partner endpoint.

requirements.title: AI addendum — decision chain for the AI output under audit
requirements.description: For a specific AI-generated observation, the PROV-O chain back to source data must be reconstructible.
